project.name: Codepot
project.tagline: Typed software intent, reusable generation, and one path from proven prototypes to a complete language platform.
project.description: Codepot is a family of complementary tools for describing software intent, producing portable contracts, applying reusable template packs, and generating code safely for developers and AI agents.

stages.title: Mature working prototypes
stages.summary: Production-used packages where new contract and generation ideas are proven against real projects.

stages.title: Official JavaScript ecosystem
stages.summary: The stable rewrite path: a frontend-neutral runtime with a thin CLI and room for web, editor, MCP, and embedded clients.

stages.title: Final Codepot platform
stages.summary: The Rust language, compiler, runtime, CLI, LSP, extension, web tooling, and MCP integration that complete the long-term project.

products.name: codepot-openapi
products.description: The original TypeScript-first contract builder. It produces OpenAPI 3.1 documents and compiler-resolved x-codegen metadata consumed by generators.
products.role: Author typed API and software contracts, then emit portable OpenAPI JSON or YAML.

products.name: codepotg
products.description: The mature Python template-pack manager and generator. It consumes OpenAPI from codepot-openapi and renders project code through Jinja packs.
products.role: Infer a normalized generation model from OpenAPI and apply bundled or project-owned Jinja template packs.

products.name: codepotx
products.description: The official release-line runtime. It stabilizes validated ideas into typed authoring, template compilation, generation planning, safe writes, and frontend-neutral runtime operations.
products.role: Provide the reusable Codepot engine that can be embedded by any user interface or developer tool.

products.name: codepotx-cli
products.description: A deliberately thin terminal frontend for codepotx. It parses commands and presents results while the project-local runtime owns all domain behavior.
products.role: Expose codepotx runtime operations through the codepotx command without duplicating engine logic.

products.name: Codepot Lang
products.description: A strongly typed semantic application language for software intent, contracts, APIs, screens, workflows, security, and reusable project foundations.
products.role: Make software meaning a first-class language understood by developers, compilers, tools, and AI agents.

products.name: Codepot compiler and runtime
products.description: The compiler, semantic analysis host, target-neutral IR, and future runtime/code-generation extension points behind the final platform.
products.role: Own parsing, typing, semantic meaning, IR, project analysis, and reusable execution boundaries.

products.name: Codepot CLI
products.description: The final command-line interface for checking, formatting, compiling, inspecting, diagnosing, and launching the language server.
products.role: Expose the final platform under the codepot command.

products.name: Codepot LSP
products.description: The Rust Language Server Protocol adapter backed by the same persistent analysis host and diagnostics as the compiler and CLI.
products.role: Provide editor-neutral diagnostics, completion, hover, navigation, rename, formatting, and project intelligence.

products.name: Codepot language extension
products.description: A thin VS Code client that registers Codepot files, provides offline grammar support, and connects the editor to the Rust language server.
products.role: Deliver Codepot language intelligence in VS Code without reimplementing compiler behavior in TypeScript.

products.name: Codepot Web
products.description: A future browser-based frontend for authoring, inspection, visualization, generation, and project workflows.
products.role: Use the same runtime and semantic artifacts through a user-friendly web experience.

products.name: Codepot MCP
products.description: A future MCP surface for exposing contracts, semantic project context, diagnostics, plans, and generation operations to AI agents.
products.role: Give AI tools structured access to Codepot instead of relying on repeated repository rediscovery.
